name: WinSSH Pro
author: lantongxue
description: A native cross-platform SSH workbench in Rust + GPUI targeting 120fps: SSH, SFTP, Telnet, serial, VNC, RDP, FTP, WebDAV and S3 in one window, with port forwarding, a credential vault, live monitoring, Docker/Swarm management, EasyTier networking and an AI assistant.
